arguments.sql:
SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS good_superheroes,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics' THEN 1 END) AS dc_superheroes,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS missing_publisher_names,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = '' THEN 1 END) AS empty_publisher_names
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN alignment AS a ON a.id = s.alignment_id
LEFT JOIN publisher AS p ON p.id = s.publisher_id
WHERE a.alignment = 'Good';
